title: Equipment Review: Best Carbon-Steel Skillets (Can This One Pan Do It All?) & Our Testing Winner
summary: America's Test Kitchen tests eight carbon-steel skillets to find the best one, asking whether a single pan can replace stainless, cast iron and nonstick. It names a winner and covers how the pans perform.
why: HN people link it as a solid explainer and review of carbon steel pans, and for seasoning guidance.
